query: SELECT id, lessonId, question, correctAnswer, options FROM exercises LIMIT 5; SELECT l.id, l.title, l.language_code, COUNT(e.id) as ex_count FROM lessons l LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.lessonId = l.id GROUP BY l.id ORDER BY ex_count ASC LIMIT 10;
